tagline: Cairo's finest selection of luxury & sports cars
heroText: A Heliopolis showroom built around a small number of cars, chosen for condition and specification.
aboutParagraphs: We hand-pick every car that enters the showroom, from Mercedes to Porsche.
Every car sits on the floor for its condition and specification, not just to fill space.
Immediate delivery and flexible finance are available on every car in the collection.
address: 151 El Sayed El Merghany, Almazah, Heliopolis, Cairo

heroText: Used SUVs across two branches, from Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Skoda and Hyundai.
aboutParagraphs: El Basma Motors is a showroom for used SUVs, carrying Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Skoda and Hyundai.
There are two branches: one in New Damietta on the Delta coast, and one in Nasr City, Cairo.
Every car on the floor is a real SUV in current stock, ready to view in person at either branch.
